2027 AGM
The Nomination Committee has been appointed in accordance with the principles resolved by the AGM held on May 12, 2026.
The members of the Nomination Committee are:
Johan Malm, appointed by E. Öhman J:or Aktiebolag, Chairman
Jake Hennemuth, appointed by Acacia Partners
Cecilia Lundberg, appointed by Lorito SPV Floreal S.à.r.l.
Lars-Åke Norling, Chairman of the Board (non-voting member)
The Nomination Committee’s task is to prepare and present proposals to the 2027 AGM regarding:
(i) election of the Chairman of the 2027 AGM,
(ii) election of members of the Board of Directors,
(iii) election of the Chairman of the Board of Directors,
(iv) remuneration to the Directors of the Board,
(v) election of the Company’s auditors,
(vi) compensation to the Company’s auditors, and
(vii) to the extent deemed necessary, amendments to principles for how to conduct the nomination process for the 2028 AGM.
